author: Ndente
quote: Rockstar didnt seem to want to make another GTA game, this feels like a modern day Red Dead, im an observer for the majority of the crazy fun stuff that would usually be a GTA story and am stuck in a really boring story within a city that has so much potential for a great, crazy, power fantasy escape from the real world, usually GTA is about building a criminal empire, im just a passanger to this game
